attachments.origin_landmark: posterior surface and muscular process of one arytenoid cartilage (the laryngeal cartilages are not modeled as skeletal elements in this pass -- approximated via the adjacent hyoid attachment region)
attachments.insertion_landmark: corresponding points on the opposite arytenoid cartilage

actions: approximates the arytenoid cartilages, closing the posterior part of the rima glottidis

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The only UNPAIRED intrinsic laryngeal muscle: a single bundle bridging the two arytenoids. It closes the posterior intercartilaginous part of the glottis that the lateral cricoarytenoids cannot reach.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
